example_en: We signed a three-year contract with the carrier.
example_zh: 我們和電信業者簽了三年的合約。

example_en: Both sides reached an agreement on pricing.
example_zh: 雙方在價格上達成協議。

example_en: Each party must keep the terms confidential.
example_zh: 各方都必須對條款保密。
note: 合約中 party 指簽約的一方，不是派對

example_en: Please check the payment clause before signing.
example_zh: 簽約前請先確認付款條款。

example_en: Please read the terms and conditions carefully.
example_zh: 請仔細閱讀條款與條件。

example_en: The contract still needs the president's signature.
example_zh: 這份合約還需要社長簽名。

example_en: Please start from our standard contract template.
example_zh: 請從我們的標準合約範本開始改。

example_en: The contract is still under legal review.
example_zh: 這份合約仍在法務審閱中。

example_en: Please send the NDA to the legal department.
example_zh: 請把保密協議送給法務部。

example_en: The effective date is April 1, 2027.
example_zh: 生效日為 2027 年 4 月 1 日。

example_en: The license expiration date is next March.
example_zh: 授權的到期日是明年三月。

example_en: Let's discuss the renewal two months in advance.
example_zh: 我們提前兩個月討論續約吧。

example_en: The contract includes an automatic renewal clause.
example_zh: 這份合約有自動續約條款。

example_en: Any amendment must be signed by both parties.
example_zh: 任何修訂都必須經雙方簽署。

example_en: We added the new price list as an addendum.
example_zh: 我們把新價目表列為增補條款。

example_en: Technical specifications are listed in Appendix A.
example_zh: 技術規格列在附錄 A。

example_en: Service fees are set out in Schedule 2.
example_zh: 服務費用載明於附表二。
note: 合約中 schedule 指附表，不是行程

example_en: The site list is attached as Exhibit B.
example_zh: 站點清單列為附件 B。

example_en: The vendor has an obligation to provide support.
example_zh: 廠商有義務提供支援。

example_en: This quote is binding for thirty days.
example_zh: 此報價三十天內具約束力。

example_en: An email confirmation can be legally binding.
example_zh: 電子郵件確認也可能具有法律效力。

example_en: The MOU is non-binding except for confidentiality.
example_zh: 除保密條款外，這份備忘錄不具約束力。

zh: 可強制執行的；有效力的
example_en: Is this clause enforceable under Taiwanese law?
example_zh: 這項條款在台灣法律下有效力嗎？

example_en: We will enforce our rights under the contract.
example_zh: 我們將依合約行使我方權利。

example_en: The quotation is valid until the end of May.
example_zh: 此報價有效至五月底。

example_en: A contract signed without authority may be void.
example_zh: 未經授權簽署的合約可能無效。

zh: 補正期間（違約後的改善期限）
example_en: The vendor has a 30-day cure period after our notice.
example_zh: 收到我方通知後，廠商有 30 天的補正期間。

example_en: Leaking customer data is a material breach.
example_zh: 洩漏客戶資料屬於重大違約。

zh: 禁制令（法院禁止某行為的命令）
example_en: The court issued an injunction to stop the sales.
example_zh: 法院核發禁制令，禁止對方繼續銷售。

example_en: The customer is claiming damages for the outage.
example_zh: 客戶因斷線事故要求損害賠償。
note: 複數 damages 指賠償金，單數 damage 指損壞

example_en: Liquidated damages are 0.1% per day of delay.
example_zh: 約定違約金為每延遲一日 0.1%。

example_en: Neither party is liable for consequential damages.
example_zh: 任一方均不對間接損害負責。

example_en: There is a penalty for early cancellation.
example_zh: 提前取消會有罰款。

example_en: The buyer claimed misrepresentation of the network coverage.
example_zh: 買方主張對方對網路涵蓋範圍做了不實陳述。

example_en: Our liability is limited to the contract value.
example_zh: 我方的賠償責任以合約金額為限。

example_en: The supplier is liable for any defects.
example_zh: 供應商須對任何瑕疵負責。

example_en: They asked us to remove the limitation of liability.
example_zh: 對方要求我們刪除責任限制條款。

example_en: The vendor shall indemnify us against third-party claims.
example_zh: 廠商應賠償我方因第三方索賠所受的損失。

example_en: The indemnity covers patent infringement claims.
example_zh: 此賠償保證涵蓋專利侵權索賠。

example_en: The statute of limitations for this claim is two years.
example_zh: 這項請求的時效是兩年。

example_en: Please review the seller's representations and warranties.
example_zh: 請審閱賣方的聲明與保證條款。

example_en: We guarantee 99.9% network availability.
example_zh: 我們保證 99.9% 的網路可用率。

example_en: The exemption clause excludes losses caused by hackers.
example_zh: 免責條款排除了駭客造成的損失。

example_en: The typhoon was treated as force majeure.
example_zh: 這次颱風被視為不可抗力。

example_en: The confidentiality obligation lasts five years.
example_zh: 保密義務持續五年。

example_en: Please sign the NDA before the technical meeting.
example_zh: 技術會議前請先簽署保密協議。

example_en: Network diagrams count as confidential information.
example_zh: 網路架構圖屬於機密資訊。

example_en: Our pricing model is a trade secret.
example_zh: 我們的定價模式是營業秘密。

example_en: Who owns the intellectual property in the new software?
example_zh: 新軟體的智慧財產權歸誰所有？

example_en: The company holds several 5G patents.
example_zh: 這家公司擁有多項 5G 專利。

example_en: Do not use our trademark without permission.
example_zh: 未經許可請勿使用我們的商標。

example_en: The copyright of the manual belongs to us.
example_zh: 這份手冊的著作權屬於我方。

example_en: They received a notice of patent infringement.
example_zh: 他們收到專利侵權通知。

example_en: The licensee may not sublicense the software to others.
example_zh: 被授權方不得將軟體再授權給他人。

example_en: The licensor keeps ownership of the source code.
example_zh: 授權方保有原始碼的所有權。

example_en: The licensee may not copy the software.
example_zh: 被授權方不得複製該軟體。

example_en: We pay a royalty for each device sold.
example_zh: 每賣出一台裝置，我們就要付權利金。

example_en: Check the open-source license before using the library.
example_zh: 使用這個函式庫前，請先確認開源授權。

example_en: Users must accept the terms of service to register.
example_zh: 使用者必須同意服務條款才能註冊。

example_en: Termination requires ninety days' notice.
example_zh: 終止合約需提前九十天通知。

example_en: Either party may terminate the agreement for breach.
example_zh: 任一方均可因對方違約而終止協議。

zh: 任意終止（無須理由的終止）
example_en: The client wants a termination for convenience clause.
example_zh: 客戶希望加入任意終止條款。

example_en: The liability cap does not cover gross negligence.
example_zh: 賠償上限不適用於重大過失。

example_en: The notice period is thirty days.
example_zh: 預告期為三十天。

example_en: Please give us written notice of any changes.
example_zh: 如有任何變更，請以書面通知我們。

example_en: The power of attorney must be notarized in Japan.
example_zh: 授權書必須在日本辦理公證。

example_en: Subcontracting requires our prior written consent.
example_zh: 轉包須事先取得我方書面同意。

example_en: A delay in action is not a waiver of rights.
example_zh: 延遲採取行動不代表放棄權利。

zh: 第三方託管（價金或原始碼）
example_en: The source code is kept in escrow with a third party.
example_zh: 原始碼交由第三方託管保存。

example_en: Assignment of this contract needs both parties' approval.
example_zh: 本合約的轉讓須經雙方同意。
note: 合約中 assignment 指轉讓，不是作業或任務

example_en: They plan to subcontract the cabling work.
example_zh: 他們打算把佈線工程轉包出去。

example_en: The main vendor is responsible for its subcontractors.
example_zh: 主承包商須為其分包商負責。

zh: 可分割性（部分無效不影響其他條款）
example_en: The severability clause protects the rest of the contract.
example_zh: 可分割條款能保障合約其餘部分的效力。

example_en: The entire agreement clause excludes earlier emails.
example_zh: 完整協議條款排除了先前往來的郵件內容。

example_en: This agreement supersedes all previous versions.
example_zh: 本協議取代先前所有版本。

example_en: If versions conflict, the English text shall prevail.
example_zh: 若版本有衝突，以英文版為準。

example_en: The governing law is the law of Japan.
example_zh: 本合約準據法為日本法。

example_en: Taipei District Court has exclusive jurisdiction.
example_zh: 以台北地方法院為專屬管轄法院。

example_en: We had a dispute over the invoice amount.
example_zh: 我們對發票金額有爭議。

example_en: The dispute resolution clause starts with negotiation.
example_zh: 爭議解決條款以協商為第一步。

example_en: Disputes will be settled by arbitration in Singapore.
example_zh: 爭議將在新加坡以仲裁解決。

example_en: Each side will appoint one arbitrator.
example_zh: 雙方各指派一名仲裁人。

example_en: Let's try mediation before going to court.
example_zh: 上法院之前，先試試調解吧。

example_en: Litigation would be costly for both companies.
example_zh: 打官司對兩家公司來說都很花錢。

example_en: The customer filed a lawsuit against the reseller.
example_zh: 客戶對經銷商提起訴訟。

example_en: They threatened to sue us for the delay.
example_zh: 對方揚言要因延誤而控告我們。

example_en: We want to avoid going to court.
example_zh: 我們希望避免上法院。

example_en: Both sides agreed to a settlement last week.
example_zh: 雙方上週同意和解。

example_en: An out-of-court settlement saves time and money.
example_zh: 庭外和解可以省時又省錢。

example_en: Claims must be submitted within thirty days.
example_zh: 索賠須在三十天內提出。

example_en: Keep the emails as evidence of their approval.
example_zh: 把這些郵件留下來，作為對方同意的證據。

example_en: The signing must be done in front of a witness.
example_zh: 簽署須在見證人面前進行。

example_en: The counterparty has not returned the signed copy.
example_zh: 相對方還沒寄回簽好的合約。

example_en: All signatories must initial each page.
example_zh: 所有簽署人都須在每頁簡簽。

example_en: Only an authorized signatory can sign this contract.
example_zh: 只有有權簽署人才能簽這份合約。

example_en: Contracts over one million need the GM's signing authority.
example_zh: 超過一百萬的合約需由總經理簽核。

example_en: The agreement was executed on June 10.
example_zh: 本協議於 6 月 10 日簽署。
note: 合約語境中 execute 指簽署生效，不只是「執行」

example_en: This contract is made in duplicate.
example_zh: 本合約一式兩份。

example_en: Please mail the original copy to our Tokyo office.
example_zh: 請將正本寄到我們東京辦公室。

example_en: Please initial every page of the contract.
example_zh: 請在合約每一頁簡簽。

example_en: Can we use an e-signature for this agreement?
example_zh: 這份協議可以用電子簽章嗎？

example_en: The Japanese headquarters requires the company seal.
example_zh: 日本總公司要求蓋公司印鑑。

example_en: The branch manager signed under a power of attorney.
example_zh: 分公司經理憑授權書代為簽署。

example_en: The two carriers signed an MOU on 5G cooperation.
example_zh: 兩家電信業者簽署了 5G 合作備忘錄。

example_en: We received a letter of intent from the buyer.
example_zh: 我們收到了買方的意向書。

example_en: Let's agree on the term sheet before drafting.
example_zh: 起草前先談定條件摘要書吧。

example_en: Each project is ordered under the MSA.
example_zh: 每個專案都依框架合約下單。

example_en: The SOW defines the scope and deliverables.
example_zh: 工作說明書定義了範圍與交付項目。

example_en: The contractor must submit a performance bond of 10%.
example_zh: 承包商須繳交 10% 的履約保證金。

example_en: Procurement is reviewing the purchase agreement.
example_zh: 採購部正在審閱採購合約。

example_en: The sales contract lists all unit prices.
example_zh: 銷售合約列出了所有單價。

example_en: We signed a distribution agreement for Taiwan.
example_zh: 我們簽了台灣區的經銷合約。

example_en: The office lease expires next December.
example_zh: 辦公室租約明年十二月到期。

example_en: They are our exclusive partner in Taiwan.
example_zh: 他們是我們在台灣的獨家合作夥伴。

example_en: They asked for two years of exclusivity.
example_zh: 對方要求兩年的獨家權。

example_en: This is a non-exclusive license.
example_zh: 這是非專屬授權。

example_en: The non-compete clause lasts one year after leaving.
example_zh: 競業禁止條款在離職後持續一年。

example_en: The non-solicitation clause protects our staff.
example_zh: 禁止招攬條款保護我們的員工不被挖角。

example_en: The joint venture will build data centers in Asia.
example_zh: 這家合資企業將在亞洲興建資料中心。

example_en: The merger needs approval from regulators.
example_zh: 這起合併案需要主管機關核准。

example_en: The acquisition was completed in March.
example_zh: 這項收購案在三月完成。

example_en: Legal due diligence will take about six weeks.
example_zh: 法律盡職調查大約需要六週。

example_en: The shareholder agreement sets out voting rights.
example_zh: 股東協議載明了表決權。

zh: 法定代理人；公司負責人
example_en: The legal representative must sign the application.
example_zh: 申請書須由公司負責人簽名。

example_en: Please include our unified business number on the invoice.
example_zh: 請在發票上註明我們的統一編號。
note: 台灣公司的統編，英文也常寫 tax ID number

zh: 營業執照；公司登記證明
example_en: The bank asked for a copy of our business license.
example_zh: 銀行要求我們提供營業登記證明影本。

example_en: We need a permit to install the antenna.
example_zh: 架設天線需要取得許可證。

example_en: Compliance with local laws is our top priority.
example_zh: 遵守當地法規是我們的首要任務。

example_en: All vendors must comply with our security policy.
example_zh: 所有廠商都必須遵守我們的資安政策。

zh: 法遵主管；法令遵循人員
example_en: Ask the compliance officer before accepting the gift.
example_zh: 收下禮物前請先詢問法遵主管。

example_en: Internal control requires two approvals for payments.
example_zh: 依內控規定，付款需經兩人核准。

example_en: New regulations on data storage take effect next year.
example_zh: 資料儲存新法規明年生效。

example_en: The regulator fined the company for false advertising.
example_zh: 主管機關因不實廣告對該公司開罰。

example_en: The launch is waiting for regulatory approval.
example_zh: 上市還在等主管機關核准。

example_en: Our anti-bribery policy bans cash gifts.
example_zh: 我們的反賄賂政策禁止贈送現金。

example_en: The bank ran an AML check on the new client.
example_zh: 銀行對新客戶做了防制洗錢審查。

example_en: Please report any conflict of interest to HR.
example_zh: 如有任何利益衝突，請向人資部門申報。

example_en: All employees must follow the code of conduct.
example_zh: 全體員工都必須遵守行為準則。

example_en: The company protects whistleblowers from retaliation.
example_zh: 公司保護吹哨者不受報復。

example_en: These chips are subject to export control.
example_zh: 這些晶片受出口管制。

example_en: Check whether the buyer is on any sanctions list.
example_zh: 請確認買方是否列在任何制裁名單上。

example_en: The Taiwan branch is not a separate legal entity.
example_zh: 台灣分公司不是獨立的法人。

zh: 個人資料保護法（個資法）
example_en: This survey must follow the Personal Data Protection Act.
example_zh: 這份問卷調查必須遵守個資法。

example_en: The cloud vendor must sign our DPA.
example_zh: 雲端廠商必須簽署我們的資料處理協議。

example_en: We updated the privacy policy on our website.
example_zh: 我們更新了官網上的隱私權政策。

example_en: Cross-border data transfer to Japan needs legal review.
example_zh: 資料跨境傳到日本需要先經法務審閱。

example_en: Our refund rules must meet consumer protection laws.
example_zh: 我們的退費規定必須符合消保法。

example_en: Online buyers have a seven-day cooling-off period.
example_zh: 網購消費者享有七天鑑賞期。

example_en: Your employment contract states your working hours.
example_zh: 你的勞動契約載明了工作時間。

example_en: The probation period is three months.
example_zh: 試用期為三個月。

example_en: Severance pay is calculated by years of service.
example_zh: 資遣費依年資計算。

example_en: Overtime rules follow the Labor Standards Act.
example_zh: 加班規定依照勞基法辦理。

example_en: Dismissal without a valid reason is illegal.
example_zh: 沒有正當理由的解僱是違法的。

example_en: The security deposit equals two months' rent.
example_zh: 押金為兩個月租金。

example_en: Late payment interest is 5% per year.
example_zh: 遲延利息為年利率 5%。

example_en: There is a ten-day grace period for payment.
example_zh: 付款有十天的寬限期。

example_en: Extra sites require a signed change order.
example_zh: 追加站點需要簽署變更單。

example_en: The deal has a minimum commitment of 500 lines.
example_zh: 這筆交易的保底用量是 500 門線路。

example_en: The damage was caused by the contractor's negligence.
example_zh: 損害是承包商的過失造成的。

example_en: The liability cap does not apply to fraud.
example_zh: 賠償上限不適用於詐欺行為。

example_en: Missing two payments counts as a default.
example_zh: 兩期未付款即視為違約。
note: 在 IT 語境是「預設值」，合約中是「違約」

example_en: We can terminate if the supplier files for bankruptcy.
example_zh: 若供應商聲請破產，我們可以終止合約。

example_en: We have an audit right once a year.
example_zh: 我們每年有一次稽核權。

example_en: Legal sent a demand letter for the unpaid invoices.
example_zh: 法務針對未付款的帳單寄出了存證信函。

example_en: We sent a cease and desist letter to the copycat site.
example_zh: 我們向仿冒網站寄發了停止侵權通知函。

example_en: Please consult legal counsel before replying.
example_zh: 回覆前請先諮詢法律顧問。

example_en: The losing party pays all legal fees.
example_zh: 敗訴方須負擔所有律師費。

example_en: This clause creates a big legal risk for us.
example_zh: 這項條款對我們造成很大的法律風險。

example_en: Please send us your redline by Wednesday.
example_zh: 請在週三前寄來你們的修訂版。

example_en: I have marked my comments in tracked changes.
example_zh: 我已用追蹤修訂標註我的意見。

example_en: Most of the last section is standard boilerplate.
example_zh: 最後一節大多是制式條款。

example_en: Always read the fine print before you sign.
example_zh: 簽名前一定要看清楚細則。

example_en: Legal found a loophole in the pricing clause.
example_zh: 法務在價格條款中發現了一個漏洞。

example_en: Whereas both parties wish to cooperate, they agree as follows.
example_zh: 鑑於雙方有意合作，茲約定如下。

example_en: ABC Telecom (hereinafter "the Supplier") agrees to the terms.
example_zh: ABC 電信（以下簡稱「供應商」）同意本條款。

example_en: We hereby confirm our acceptance of your offer.
example_zh: 我們特此確認接受貴方報價。

example_en: Notwithstanding Article 5, fees are non-refundable.
example_zh: 不受第五條影響，費用一概不予退還。

example_en: Payment is made pursuant to Section 4.
example_zh: 付款依第四條辦理。

example_en: Data is stored in accordance with company policy.
example_zh: 資料依公司政策保存。

example_en: The price is subject to final approval.
example_zh: 此價格須經最終核准才算確定。

example_en: The buyer shall pay within thirty days.
example_zh: 買方應於三十天內付款。
note: 合約中 shall 表示法律義務，比 will 更正式

example_en: We prefer a mutual NDA instead of a one-way one.
example_zh: 我們比較希望簽雙向保密協議，而不是單向的。

example_en: Both parties will negotiate in good faith.
example_zh: 雙方將本於誠信進行協商。

example_en: The vendor will use reasonable efforts to fix bugs.
example_zh: 廠商將以合理努力修正錯誤。

example_en: Bonuses are paid at the company's sole discretion.
example_zh: 獎金由公司全權決定是否發放。

example_en: Do not disclose the data to any third party.
example_zh: 請勿將資料揭露給任何第三方。

example_en: Our affiliates in Japan may also use the license.
example_zh: 我們在日本的關係企業也可以使用此授權。

example_en: Costs include, but are not limited to, travel and shipping.
example_zh: 費用包括但不限於差旅費與運費。

example_en: For the avoidance of doubt, prices exclude tax.
example_zh: 為避免疑義，價格皆未稅。

example_en: Unless otherwise agreed, delivery is within four weeks.
example_zh: 除非另有約定，否則四週內交貨。

en: to the extent permitted by law
example_en: To the extent permitted by law, we exclude all implied warranties.
example_zh: 在法律允許的範圍內，我們排除所有默示保證。

example_en: The supplier will replace defective parts at its own expense.
example_zh: 供應商將自費更換瑕疵零件。

example_en: We terminate the agreement with immediate effect.
example_zh: 我們終止本協議，立即生效。

example_en: They rejected our price and made a counteroffer.
example_zh: 他們拒絕了我們的價格，另外提出還價。

example_en: A verbal agreement is hard to prove later.
example_zh: 口頭協議事後很難舉證。

example_en: We need to negotiate the liability terms again.
example_zh: 我們需要再協商責任條款。

example_en: The client wants to renegotiate the monthly fee.
example_zh: 客戶想重新協商月費。

example_en: The total contract value is NT$12 million.
example_zh: 合約總金額為新台幣一千兩百萬元。

example_en: The contract period is two years from signing.
example_zh: 合約期間為簽約起兩年。

example_en: We use a system for contract management and renewals.
example_zh: 我們用一套系統做合約管理與續約提醒。
